metadata.title: खुमलुंग का आदिवासी बाज़ार | Khumulwng Tribal Bazaar | Tribal Life | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Khumlung, the headquarters of the Tripura Tribal Autonomous District Council (TTADC), serves as a bustling marketplace where tribals from surrounding villages gather to sell their products. The offerings primarily include produce from their Jhoom (shifting cultivation) fields, alongside forest products, fresh fish, and snails. All items sold in this market are completely organic, grown or sourced naturally without any chemicals, reflecting the sustainable and eco-friendly lifestyle of the tribal communities. The market is vital in supporting local livelihoods and preserving traditional agricultural practices.
